teaser.en: Almost every Digo pot starts the same way: with *chitunguu madzi* sizzling at the bottom.
teaser.sw: Karibu kila chungu cha Kidigo huanza kwa njia ileile: *chitunguu madzi* kikichacharika chini yake.
teaser.dg: Karibu chila nyungu ya Adigo inaandza vivyo hivyo: *chitunguu madzi* chichikalangwa photsi.

summary.en: *Chitunguu madzi* is the onion, the base for most cooking on the coast. It is mostly bought, though some people grow it in small gardens.
summary.sw: *Chitunguu madzi* ni kitunguu, msingi wa mapishi mengi pwani. Mara nyingi hununuliwa, ingawa watu wengine hukipanda katika bustani ndogo.
summary.dg: *Chitunguu madzi* (kpwa Chingereza *onion*) ndicho msingi wa kujita vyakurya vinji pwani. Vitunguu madzi vinji nkugulwa, ela atu anjina nkuvirima kpwenye busitani ndide.

about.en: The onion is a bulb with hollow, tubular leaves. The bulb is made of tightly layered, fleshy leaf bases wrapped in papery skin, which may be red, brown or white. Cut it and the sharp, eye-watering smell is unmistakable.
about.sw: Kitunguu ni tunguu lenye majani yenye uwazi ndani, kama mirija. Tunguu hilo limeundwa kwa matabaka yaliyobanana ya vitako vya majani vyenye nyama, yaliyofunikwa na ganda jembamba kama karatasi, ambalo linaweza kuwa jekundu, la kahawia au jeupe. Ukikikata, harufu yake kali inayotoa machozi haikosei.
about.dg: *Chitunguu madzi* ni *bulb* yenye makodza ganayokala mahuphu ndani dza mridza. *Bulb* inahendwa ni seemu za photsi za makodza, nene na zenye madzi, zirizobanana tabaka kpwa tabaka, na zinafwinikpwa ni gada dzembamba dza karatasi, ririroweza kukala ra kundu, ra rangi ya dongo au rereru. Uchichikata, arufuye kali inayolavya matsozi ni rahisi sana kuimanya.

where.en: Onions are mostly bought in markets, though some are grown in small home gardens.
where.sw: Vitunguu mara nyingi hununuliwa sokoni, ingawa vingine hupandwa katika bustani ndogo za nyumbani.
where.dg: Vitunguu madzi vinji nkugulwa cheteni, ela vinjina nkurimwa kpwenye busitani ndide za midzini.

uses.en: The onion is the base for most cooking. It is also the main ingredient, with tomato, of *kachumbari*, the fresh salad served with many coastal meals.
uses.sw: Kitunguu ndicho msingi wa mapishi mengi. Pia ni kiambato kikuu, pamoja na nyanya, cha *kachumbari*, saladi mbichi inayoliwa na milo mingi ya pwani.
uses.dg: *Chitunguu madzi* ndicho msingi wa kujita vyakurya vinji. Piya ni chitu chikulu, phamwenga na nyanya, cha *kachumbari*, saladi ya vitu dza virivyo inayoandazwa na vyakurya vinji vya pwani.

names.en: The Digo name is *chitunguu madzi*. Swahili calls it *kitunguu*. In English it is onion. Garlic is *chitunguu saumu*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *chitunguu madzi*. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *kitunguu*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *onion*. Kitunguu saumu ni *chitunguu saumu*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *chitunguu madzi*. Kpwa Chiswahili chinaihwa *kitunguu*. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *onion*. *Garlic* kpwa Chidigo ni *chitunguu saumu*.

reason.en: Another everyday flavouring of the coastal pot
reason.sw: Kikolezo kingine cha kila siku cha chungu cha pwani
reason.dg: Chitu chanjina cha chila siku cha kupha ladha vyakurya vya nyungu ya pwani

reason.sw: Mzizi mwingine wa kila siku jikoni
reason.dg: Muzi wanjina wa chila siku wa dzikoni
